key_provisions_or_claims: State Department of Education must publish AI guidance for local school systems, educators, parents and students, updated annually
Each local school system must adopt an AI policy within 120 days of guidance release and designate an AI coordinator
Department develops rubric for evaluating AI tools; local systems must use it and procure consistent with state procurement law
AI literacy to be included in workforce preparation standards by June 1, 2027; statewide teacher PD by July 1, 2027
Creates Maryland AI Education Collaborative reporting annually from Dec 1, 2027; effective June 1, 2026
annotation.summary_en: Maryland statute (Ch. 634, SB 720, 2026) requiring the State Department of Education to issue AI guidance, an AI-tool evaluation rubric and teacher professional development. It requires local school AI policies and coordinators, adds AI literacy to workforce standards, and creates the Maryland AI Education Collaborative.
